verdict.rationale: The API is path-versioned (GET /api/v1/models) and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, which is thin evidence of a versioned API surface. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or breaking-change notices; the 'latest' alias covers model resolution, not API versioning. Missing for 10: a documented API deprecation/sunset policy, an explicit API versioning scheme or changelog, and independent corroboration of version stability.
